_comment: Floors and ceilings for bench/bench_serving.py --check. Paths index into bench/results/serving.json with '/' (the keys themselves contain dots). Timing-derived ratios are set well below the values measured on the development machine (Windows 10, 6 CPUs, CPython 3.12, numpy 2.x, BLAS pinned to one thread) because shared CI runners are noisy: they catch a design regression, not a few percent of drift. The admission and memory rows do not depend on timing and are tight.
